'''Kaiya Stas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Around [[3641 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> Kaiya Stas was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], trying to stop a legendary wampa called the [[White Terror]]. The wampa was on the rampage and threatened to devour an entire [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colony. Injured during her hunt, Kaiya asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] for help. The hero lured White Terror out of its lair and killed the beast.<ref name="ICIF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaiya Stas appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a quest-giver for the quest "''I Came, I Froze, I...''". The quest is available for any Republic character and its completion is optional. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means the quest is completed.<ref name="ICIF" />

==Appearances==
